node.title: Rank-eleven heavy-plane minimal-field stratification fence
node.closure: the heavy Segre bucket splits exactly by minimal field degree, while automatic base-field descent is ruled out as a consequence of the current algebraic interface alone
node.statement: For the official KoalaBear sextic row, every used factor record in the heavy rank-four Segre bucket has a unique minimal field of definition over the domain-generated base field B. Its relative degree is one of 1,2,3,6. The retained mass 9965407986 therefore has a degree stratum of mass at least 2491351997, and the fixed-factor cap 248644099 forces that stratum to use at least 11 projective factors. Degree one is the base-rational interface; degrees 2,3,6 are exact extension-generated alternatives. A symbolic degree-six 2 x 2 product packet shows that field-internal Segre form, base-freeness, product rank four, 41 used factors, and the fixed-factor mass cap do not by themselves force degree one. Any further descent must use the received-line, ownership, support, or Galois-transfer semantics not present in that algebraic interface.
